description: Harder questions that stress the digest: multi-hop (combine facts across two commands in one session) and adversarial phrasing (negation, synonyms, distractors). Deterministic graders. kind 'auto' = let netdistill detect per chunk (multi-command session logs).

cases.question: The most-used next-hop IP in the routing table belongs to one of the BGP peers. What is that peer's AS number?
The BGP peer advertising the most prefixes has an IP address. How many routes in the routing table use that IP as their next-hop? Answer with just the number.
Ignoring any peer that is administratively shut down, which peer is in a genuinely broken (unestablished, non-admin) state? Give its IP address.
Which uplink interface is discarding traffic on egress (dropping packets on output)? Give the interface name.
Which interface is operationally UP yet still logging input errors? Give its name.
